name: quoin-collab
description: The collaboration server behind Quoin, the browser provider that talks to it, and the wire protocol they share.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace quoin-collab-protocol && npm run build --workspace quoin-collab-server && npm run build --workspace quoin-collab-client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/protocol && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/protocol/test && tsc -p packages/server/test && tsc -p packages/client/test
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:consumer
